title: Relocatable industrial accommodation (Part 10): certification by an approved organization and labelling of renovated units
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 (National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: October 2025 (platform created October 30, 2025, last updated November 7, 2025)

facts.text: The interpretation recognises new Part 10 units certified and labelled to CSA-A277 and clarifies renovation and labelling for existing Part 10 units.
Relocatable industrial camp buildings constructed after May 01, 2024 must be certified by an organization approved by the Provincial Building Administrator.
Conformance to CSA-A277 is an acceptable solution for Part 10 buildings under Division C.
For existing units, renovations must be labelled appropriately under Sentence 10.1.1.4.(2) of Division B.
